title: P15 left residual defects that an independent review found (preservation-check trap, unquoted --since, fresh-B window, NULL payments, A28' restore, switch =0, B6 count)
what_went_wrong: N1: p10_preservation_check.sh installed its EXIT trap before its refusals; the trap restores database.xml and revokes the fixture grant unconditionally (v11 S2 left open in a file the A2 package named).
N2: p15_line_negctl.sh passed --since $SINCE unquoted, so the comparator received a midnight timestamp and B5 was never tested at the run-start boundary.
N3: fresh-B counted only INSERTs at or after the run start, so a stale pre-run INSERT was ignored.
N4: COALESCE turned a NULL payment into 0 in both comparators.
N5: the A28' predicate did not assert the restore result; the conditional -5 ran in either arm.
N6: the suite mapped any non-empty switch (including 0) to 1, undoing the exact-1 rule of the oracle.
N7: B6 plants asserted ROW_COUNT >= 1, not an exact count.
R5 section 27 stated several of these as done (a refusal touches nothing; the restore result is asserted; B5b before the run start).
root_cause: Each control and claim was checked against the package text, not against every file the package named; the control for B5 was run with a value that happened to satisfy the weaker boundary.
detection: docs/khanza_r5_p15_review.md (independent read-only reviewer, 17/24 against the executor's 23/24); each item confirmed against the source before P16.
impact: No false result reached an outside party; the P15 self-score was overstated by 6 points; the claims in R5 section 27 were struck through.

correction.applied: P16 (docs/khanza_r5_task_p16_review_fixes.md): fixes N1-N8, old-vs-new controls for each, C4 rerun under the stricter fresh-B rule.

rule: A claim of the form 'every X touches nothing / asserts Y' is checked by grepping all files of the class, and a boundary control must record the value it actually used.
